name: cxr_measurement_tool
description: Deterministic CXR clinical metrics: computes cardiothoracic ratio, finding sizes, and lung-zone distribution from detection boxes and/or segmentation regions. No model required.

help.summary: Compute cardiothoracic ratio and finding measurements from detection/segmentation outputs.

options.name: score
options.description: Detection confidence threshold when it runs detection itself.

notes: Deterministic; pulls detection/segmentation via run_tool when artifacts are not supplied.
